description:
<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-16. -->
## YouTube Music

- **Smart Shuffle:** Mix playlist recommendations among your songs without delaying playback. Touch and hold
  the playlist header's Shuffle button to toggle it; a sparkle shows when enabled. With native Shuffle on,
  start using Play or a song. Suggestions show a sparkle on the right; Keep adds one to a playlist and
  Dismiss removes only that queue entry. Android Auto labels them Suggested. Going offline removes unplayed
  suggestions without interrupting the current song; downloaded-playlist playback is unchanged. Off by
  default, on Music 9.15.51 and 9.40.51, with 9.45.51 experimental; older versions skip with a warning.
- **Settings shortcut (#51):** Open the populated native settings list instead of a blank screen. Match the
  gear to Bold and Bold (stock size) using Music's native bold icon.
- **Music 6.20 compatibility (#52):** Keep the accepted 8.04.51 browse client without changing playback's
  version. Restore nested layouts, themes and native multirow carousels, and supply missing playlist
  statistics text styling. Preserve custom toolbar headers; skip incompatible navigation-icon remapping
  with a warning. Music 8.x and 9.x are unchanged.

## YouTube

- **Player settings menu (#53):** Restore hiding Sleep timer, Quality, Playback speed, Help, Stats for nerds
  and Listen with YouTube Music on newer menus. Hide active captions and loop rows too, and let Listening
  controls hide its own row without changing account capabilities. Add **Hide Additional settings / More**;
  More also hides automatically when every child hide option is on, including Sleep timer, so it cannot
  open an empty sheet. It stays available when any child hide option is off.
- **Player startup crash (#52):** Prevent media-key and timestamp crashes before the activity context is
  attached. Preserve timestamp menus and double-tap remaining-time toggling; resolve view-specific icons
  and descriptions only when their views are available.

## Both apps

- **GmsCore support (#52):** Fix non-root patching on experimental **YouTube 21.45.90** and **Music 9.45.51**
  by handling the updated initialization check. Existing versions are unchanged. Recommended defaults
  remain **YouTube 21.39.525** and **Music 9.40.51**.
